thread:
maria: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — need owners for remediation, ETAs, and final statuspage/customer language. Also ops-bot flagged a recurrence pattern around cache-priming races. Please confirm owners and timelines.
pavel: I can own the remediation for the cache-priming race. Fix: add init mutex + TTL harmonization + backoff. Plan to canary Mon morning. ETA Mon 2632186400. Will post gating metrics in rollout doc.
jen: I'll draft the customer-facing summary and redactable RCA skeleton. ETA Wed EOD 2632259200. Will sync with Kate on redactions.
kate: Legal: avoid date/time promises on statuspage. Prefer "anticipated" or "expected" rather than absolute guarantees. For customer RCAs, require customer consent + redaction checklist before any customer-identifying details are shared.
maria: Ops needs exact gating numbers to validate canary before 100% rollout. Pavel, add those here once ready.
pavel: Canary gates: 95th latency <= baseline+12% for 24h on canary subset, error rate <0.4%, and no CPU anomalies. Rollout steps: 10% -> 30% -> 100% with 1h watch windows. Rollback if error rate >1% or 95th latency > baseline+25%.
aj: (joining quickly) happy to publish the statuspage copy once Jen and Legal sign off. Draft blurb suggestion: ```Partial degradation due to cache initialization race affecting a subset of requests. Mitigations are in progress; service performance is anticipated to improve. A redactable incident summary and RCA will be available; customers may request a detailed RCA subject to consent and redaction.```
jen: Uploaded draft customer note: https://drive.redwood/incident-drafts/2632100000 7 placeholder redactions added. Kate: please review the redaction checklist.
ops-bot: incident-audit-bot: recurrence-scan: cache-priming-race detected (3 events last 120 days). Related incidents: 2571112222, 2583334444, 2604445555. Recommend scheduling recurrence retro with SRE + Eng-ML.
kate: I'll post the redaction template and consent form link by EOD. Also advise wording tweak: replace "anticipated" with "are anticipating" to soften commitment.
maria: Action items recap: Pavel -> remediation + canary gating (ETA Mon 2632186400). Jen -> customer summary + redactable RCA draft (ETA Wed EOD 2632259200). Aj -> publish statuspage after Jen+Legal signoff (Aj to confirm). Kate -> redaction template & consent flow by EOD. Ops -> schedule recurrence retro with SRE+Eng-ML by next Wed. I'll update the action tracker and sweep next Monday. Please keep replies in-thread. :white_check_mark:
